# Catppuccin Latte

<a href="https://justcarlson.github.io/omarchy-wallpapers/#catppuccin-latte"><img src="../docs/mosaics/catppuccin-latte.jpg" alt="All 14 Catppuccin Latte wallpapers"></a>

14 wallpapers picked for Catppuccin Latte by how closely Aether's palette for each image matches the theme's colours.

Install just this set:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justcarlson/omarchy-wallpapers/main/install.sh | bash -s -- catppuccin-latte
```

Then press <kbd>Super</kbd> <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> to pick one. To build a whole new theme from a wallpaper instead, import its Aether blueprint:

```sh
aether --import-blueprint https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justcarlson/omarchy-wallpapers/main/blueprints/catppuccin-latte/<name>.json --auto-apply
```
